snippet.title: Dread Meridian - Pre-order Now
snippet.description:
The deeper you go, the thicker the air you can hardly breathe.
Past the snowfields and the cabins… into the underground laboratory, where the secrets were hidden — and where everything spiraled out of control.
What lies below carries echoes of an old Antarctic terror, inspired by the chilling depths of Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness, now reborn into an original experience that reshapes the dread beneath the ice.

👀 Get ready for a new glimpse into the truth buried beneath Oglanbyen.

👉 Click to Pre-Order: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/dread-meridian/24017323877931160/
